rv.q: Simon Godwin does this triumphantly in his whirling, modern-dress production of Man and Superman .
What is astonishing about Godwin’s production is that it triumphs where Shaw’s play is most difficult.
Fiennes proves his star status in every moment of this marathon role, oozing the heroic vigour we know from his classical work and the comic brio from The Grand Budapest Hotel .
There comes a point when one stops admiring Shaw’s intellect and argumentation, and Ralph Fiennes’ central performance, and wishes GBS would just edit himself a bit.
At the end of three hours and 40 minutes, you stagger out of the theatre mighty glad you’ve survived this torrential outpouring of words.

cn.t: Critics largely praise Ralph Fiennes's commanding performance in this marathon Shaw revival, though some find the 3.5-hour runtime a test of endurance. Godwin's modern-dress production earns mostly positive notices despite divided views on its updating.
